AwardSettlement/Paper/ExperimentalLogNot: EXPERIMENT LOG 021
The zombie intelligence trials based on the eleventh-generation gene-enhancement agent have achieved initial success.
The subjects' intelligence has improved markedly, and they have begun learning to use a wider range of tools and equipment.
This is a promising start. I can already see a bright future ahead.
DR. EDGAR
EXPERIMENT LOG 045
Construction is underway on the first aerosol dispersal units. Once complete, they will release the twelfth-generation gene-enhancement agent at several zombie gathering sites.
The agent is expected to trigger a large-scale evolution among the zombies.
Just wait. One day, I will make that fellow hand over his own brain.
DR. EDGAR
EXPERIMENT LOG 053
The XII gene-enhancement gas has greatly improved the zombies' intelligence and social behavior. They have begun devising new ways to assault the garden on their own.
Composite equipment for these new zombies has entered production planning.
The look on that fellow's face will be priceless. I can hardly wait to see what becomes of that ugly mug. Ha ha!
DR. EDGAR
EXPERIMENT LOG 062
Under the influence of an unknown factor, the properties of the gene-enhancement gas have begun to deviate slightly from the original design.
No abnormal effects on zombies have yet been observed. Further observation is required.
DR. EDGAR
EXPERIMENT LOG 068
At 05:47 today, the gas-dispersal facility began vibrating abnormally. The likely cause is irregular flow brought on by changes in the gas itself.
Repairs are underway as I record this. The situation is relatively stable for now.
EXPERIMENT LOG 069
The explosion caused tremendous losses.
Fortunately, the completed zombie army has shown no unusual changes so far. I still command enough force to flatten that garden.
As for the escaped gas drifting through the atmosphere? Perhaps it will cause changes somewhere beyond my sight...
Whatever. I will not waste my time worrying about it.
DR. EDGAR
HOMEOWNER:
I foresaw this outcome long ago. As your old rival, I sincerely congratulate you on protecting your brains and home once again.
But alas... you are still as foolish as ever—too foolish to see the truth!
You do not think defeating me brings all this to an end, do you?
This experiment has never affected only you and me. Others are caught in it too.
I have abandoned this game. What comes next will be your real problem!
Let us see if you can still laugh then. Ha ha!
SINCERELY,
DR. EDGAR
EXPERIMENT LOG 082
The altered properties of the twelfth-generation gene-enhancement agent (XII) have now been tentatively identified.
The unstable XII has changed. It can affect plant genes and induce mutations. With specific artificial guidance, selected genes and traits can be combined.
That fellow's experiments appear to have been built upon this very principle.
That damned thief!
DR. EDGAR
EXPERIMENT LOG 094
Further observations have been made on the effects of altered XII on humans.
There is still no clear evidence that XII directly affects the human genome.
However, prolonged exposure appears to cause psychological and cognitive abnormalities, including excessive zeal and obsession toward particular subjects—research projects, for example.
I believe I may have a problem.
DR. EDGAR
